description_en: Deletes a specified version of a workflow template
description_zh: 删除工作流模板的指定版本
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo delete-workflow-template-version --collaboration-group-id group_example --template-id tpl_example --biz-version v2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteWorkflowTemplateVersion

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If this parameter is not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collaboration workspace
parameters.name: collaboration_group_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the template to be deleted. The format is a lowercase v followed by a positive integer, such as v1. The version cannot be the current active version
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的模板版本号，格式为小写 v + 正整数，例如 v1；不能是当前生效版本
parameters.name: version

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

effectiveVersion.description_en: The current active version number. An empty value indicates that only a draft exists
effectiveVersion.description_zh: 当前生效版本号；为空表示仅有草稿

items.description_en: All remaining versions after deletion, sorted in descending order by version number
items.description_zh: 删除后剩余的全部版本，按版本号倒序

items.description_en: All remaining versions after deletion, sorted in descending order by version number
items.description_zh: 删除后剩余的全部版本，按版本号倒序

createdByUserId.description_en: The ID of the user who created the version

description.description_en: The description of the template for this version. This can be used for display when version v1 has no version description
description.description_zh: 该版本的模板描述；v1 无版本说明时可用于展示

gmtCreate.description_en: The time when the version was created. The time is in the ISO 8601 format

gmtModified.description_en: The time when the version was modified. The time is in the ISO 8601 format

gmtSubmitted.description_en: The time when the version was submitted. The time is in the ISO 8601 format. This is empty for a draft
gmtSubmitted.description_zh: 版本提交时间(ISO8601)；草稿为空

isEffective.description_en: Indicates whether the version is the only current active version
isEffective.description_zh: 是否为当前唯一生效版本

name.description_en: The name of the template for this version

sourceVersion.description_en: The submitted version number on which this version is based. This is empty for a newly created v1 version. Saving or submitting a draft retains the original source version
sourceVersion.description_zh: 创建该版本所基于的已提交版本号；新建 v1 为空，草稿保存或提交保留原来源版本

status.description_en: The version status. Valid values: DRAFT (draft) and SUBMITTED (submitted)
status.description_zh: 版本状态：DRAFT 草稿 / SUBMITTED 已提交

stepCount.description_en: The number of steps in this version

submittedByUserId.description_en: The ID of the user who submitted the version. This is empty for a draft
submittedByUserId.description_zh: 版本提交人用户ID；草稿为空

updatedByUserId.description_en: The ID of the user who last modified the version

versionDescription.description_en: The persisted version change description. An empty value indicates that no description is provided
versionDescription.description_zh: 持久化的版本变更说明；为空表示未填写
